top_signals.title: How Sudan Became a Laboratory for Drone Warfare, Thanks to Abu Dhabi
top_signals.summary:
In June 2026, I visited Khartoum, my hometown, for the first time since the war broke out in Sudan in April 2023. I left the city to seek safety with my family after the war spread into civilian neighborhoods. I never imagined I would return to the same city. I was very excited but also traumatized by the destruction I saw as the plane landed at Khartoum International Airport.
